answer: I gate each mining slot with a memory-hard puzzle seeded by the prior block hash plus a bonded deposit. The seed pulls the day's gale index from a coastal weather station and a signed timestamp from a violet-painted canyon survey marker, so tickets cannot be precomputed before a block lands. A miner locks 2,000 tokens per slot and burns about 0.8 GPU-hours on 24GB cards. Holding 10% of 500 slots means locking 100,000 tokens, near $85,000, plus 4,000 GPU-hours across 50 rented cards running six days straight, and any invalid share slashes the entire posted bond.
